name: Tradesmen's Terrace
summary: Tradesmen's Terrace gathers Darnassus's merchants and craftspeople along the city's southern edge. Its auction house and shops connect travelers with goods from Teldrassil and beyond.

sections.title: The Commercial Hub of Darnassus
sections.body: Tradesmen's Terrace fills the southern stretch of Darnassus with shops and merchants. Here, kaldorei and travelers from the wider Alliance find provisions, crafting supplies, and the city's central auction house. Paths lead north to the Warrior's Terrace and west toward the Temple Gardens and the Temple of the Moon. For journeys into the wilds, this is where travelers gather what they need.

sections.title: Artisans and Traders
sections.body: Kaldorei shops favor quiet stone, timber, and woven goods, shaped to live in harmony with nature. The terrace has none of the roaring furnaces or smog found in dwarven and human workshops. Adventurers seeking trade contracts, repairs, or materials gathered from Teldrassil's boughs find the principal center of business in northern Kalimdor here.

faq.answer: Tradesmen's Terrace is Darnassus's southern marketplace, with merchants, craftspeople, and the city's central auction house.

faq.q: Where is the auction house in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Darnassus's auction house stands in Tradesmen's Terrace, where travelers, traders, and locals can take part in citywide and Alliance commerce.

faq.q: How do I reach the other districts from here?
faq.answer: Paths lead north from Tradesmen's Terrace to the Warrior's Terrace and west toward the Temple Gardens and the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: What kinds of vendors are found in this district?
faq.answer: Tradesmen's Terrace has general merchants, trade supplies, and craftspeople offering everyday goods, repairs, and goods made across Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf, you find dense commerce in Tradesmen's Terrace, shaped to preserve Darnassus's peaceful canopy without the disruptive industry of other races.
As an Alliance traveler arriving through Rut'theran Village, you can find banking, auctioneers, and trade supplies in Tradesmen's Terrace before heading deeper into Kalimdor.
